Definition: to rage or be violent; by implication, to suppress, to maltreat
BiblicalUsage: 1) to oppress, suppress, treat violently, maltreat, vex, do wrong; 1a) (Qal) to oppress, suppress; 1b) (Hiphil) to treat violently, maltreat
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
